column1: SEPARATOR SIZING CALCULATION TOOL - MKS UNITS
SOUDERS-BROWN EQUATION: V_max = K × √[(ρ_L - ρ_G) / ρ_G]
This calculation tool is for preliminary design and conceptual studies.
All dimensions are in MKS (SI) units.
Final vessel design must comply with ASME Section VIII Div.1 pressure vessel standards.
Consult design standards: API 12J, GPSA Engineering Data Book, ASME Section VIII.
Recommended review by licensed professional engineer before procurement.
Safety factors and margins are included in K-factor values.
